It's fantastic for Emerald Sanctum, AQ40, Naxxramas and all dungeons. However, it suffers a bit in Molten Core since many of the mobs and bosses have high fire resistance or complete fire immunity, as do many of the drakes and dragons of Blackwing Lair and Onyxia. author: RUTHINAS
content:
Coming back to this, here's my post over on the Meme Spec discord: https://discord.com/channels/1232080448348229714/1234084166119854080/1246577161469690017

To sum it up, at 800 spellpower from gear, against a target with full Scorch stacks, the Ornate Bloodstone Dagger is equal in strength to a weapon which gives you 555 spellpower. However, it does come with the tradeoff of taking _a lot_ of damage from its procs, so it may not be suitable for use under all conditions. It's not 4,7% haste. Haste works multiplicatively, so when all your stuff procs: tbos 1,05. * whip 1,03 * talents 1,05 * gear 1,01^8 (rough estimate) * AP 1,30 * 5t3 1,05 = ~167% castspeed. Casttime will be around 60% of base.

The set has a good uptime and only gets better with buffs and better gear (more haste/crit).
